ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Professional Practice. This online course is open for fine art students from different disciplines. Students create CV, grant/exhibition/artist residency proposal, application for open call, artist statements, photo representation of artwork, social media handle, and website. Readings on practicing artists will also be the ground of this course. Virtual Chicago commercial/artist run/non-profit gallery and museum visits will be provided. The students will also work and polish a long term project. Online section.
